build_evidence.status: existing untracked local build artifact; inspected but not rebuilt in this task
build_evidence.boundary: Because site-dna was already present and is not tracked at the pinned Git HEAD, this audit does not claim a byte-for-byte reproducible build. It records the exact existing HTML/CSS plus fresh local renders.

render_evidence.screenshots: 14 temporary PNG files were visually inspected and SHA-256 hashed; they are verification aids and are intentionally not committed.

supplementary_mobile.observation: The primary and secondary sidebars collapse behind the top bar, body text becomes a single column, and the wide first workflow diagram extends beyond the narrow viewport and is visibly clipped. This single mobile render establishes a boundary, not full cross-device coverage.

cross_sample_observations: At desktop width, most pages use a stable three-zone reading shell: hierarchical navigation at left, restrained prose column in the center, and an in-page outline at right when headings exist.
The shell is visually quiet: white background, cyan top bar and links, gray slab-serif headings, dark body copy, generous inter-section spacing, and monospace treatment for code or technical tokens.

Information density changes by teaching function. Route pages expose deeper outlines and more links; course cards surface five decision fields before prose; workflow pages let diagrams carry relationships; short cards end after resources without artificial recap sections.
These are observed affordances, not a mandate that every learning article copy the three-column shell or course-card field order.

records.title: CS自学指南
records.visual_observation: A cyan top bar spans the captured desktop viewport. The opening uses a large centered brand graphic, then a gray '前言' heading and a blue release line; left navigation and the right section outline frame the central prose.
records.teaching_function: identity and orientation before the site's argument and navigation choices

records.title: 如何使用这本书 - CS自学指南
records.visual_observation: A compact three-item right outline mirrors the three reader paths. Long explanatory paragraphs remain in the same centered column; no decorative visual interrupts the reader classification.
records.teaching_function: choose a route by reader state rather than browse every page

records.title: 一个仅供参考的CS学习规划 - CS自学指南
records.visual_observation: The page opens with the scope warning and a prominent blue overview-course link. The right outline is much denser than on ordinary cards, exposing nested domains and letting readers jump rather than scroll linearly.
records.teaching_function: map prerequisites and domains while preserving reader-controlled navigation

records.title: 日常学习工作流 - CS自学指南

The three-box collection→processing→review diagram appears before the first mechanism section, while the right outline previews the same progression. On the supplemental narrow render, this wide diagram is clipped rather than fully scaled.
records.teaching_function: let diagrams progressively assemble a relationship-heavy personal workflow

records.title: 信息检索 - CS自学指南
records.visual_observation: An italicized, blunt opening rule leads into prose and a numbered three-stage mechanism. The right outline splits principles, engine operation, query techniques and code-search contexts; hierarchy does most of the wayfinding.
records.teaching_function: move from a memorable search rule to mechanism and situational procedures

records.title: UCB CS61A: Structure and Interpretation of Computer Programs - CS自学指南
records.visual_observation: The course title is followed immediately by a five-field bulleted card: university, prerequisites, languages, difficulty suns and estimated time. Judgment and a beginner-risk warning follow before resource links.
records.teaching_function: support a go/no-go course decision before asking the reader to invest time

records.title: Harvard CS50: This is CS50x - CS自学指南
records.visual_observation: The same five-field decision block fits above a very short appraisal, then course and community links. The sparse page ends naturally instead of padding the recommendation into a long lesson.
records.teaching_function: deliver a low-friction beginner recommendation with enough cost and resource information

records.title: MIT18.06: Linear Algebra - CS自学指南
records.visual_observation: After the standard decision fields, a large book cover anchors the specific fifth-edition recommendation. The page keeps substantial white space rather than surrounding the image with dense callouts.
records.teaching_function: identify a particular textbook edition while preserving the course decision card

records.title: CMU 15-213: CSAPP - CS自学指南
records.visual_observation: The five-field card makes the 150-hour cost and three-sun difficulty visible before the strongly worded warning against copying project answers. Resource bullets begin in the first screenful.
records.teaching_function: make commitment and academic-integrity boundaries part of the recommendation

records.title: MIT 6.S081: Operating System Engineering - CS自学指南
records.visual_observation: A five-sun difficulty signal and demanding prerequisites lead into several evidence-rich paragraphs. The right outline previews official resources, xv6 supplements and blogs rather than forcing those sources into the opening.
records.teaching_function: separate fit/cost signals, experiential judgment and layered follow-up resources

records.title: CMU 15-445: Database Systems - CS自学指南
records.visual_observation: Prerequisites and 100-hour cost sit above prose that names concrete Bustub components. Inline code styling makes shell.cpp and project identifiers visible without turning the page into a code-heavy tutorial.
records.teaching_function: connect a course decision to tangible system components and feedback mechanisms

records.title: CMU 15-462 - CS自学指南
records.visual_observation: A standard decision card is followed by one dense scope paragraph and a resource list. The page's minimal outline reflects its reference-card function and does not manufacture narrative stages.
records.teaching_function: quickly expose breadth, prerequisites and primary learning resources

records.title: UCSD CSE234: Data Systems for Machine Learning - CS自学指南
records.visual_observation: A broad prerequisite line precedes a three-part curriculum written as labeled paragraphs and bullets. The first screen shows computation, GPU/kernel, memory and LLM-system scope rather than hiding prerequisites under links.
records.teaching_function: bound a fast-moving systems course by prerequisites, subsystems and extension paths

records.title: 学习路线图 - CS自学指南
records.visual_observation: The page opens with scope disclosure and an explicit correction that LLMs are one branch of generative modeling, then uses linked bullets for course families. With no H2/H3, there is no visible right-hand section list despite the shared shell.
records.teaching_function: correct a hotspot-driven mental model and route readers among model, implementation and systems options
